# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(GenomeInfoDb)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  library(data.table)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(future)
  library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
})

SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()   
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")                     
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")

output_dir   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output", "feature_scores", "signac")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 2. Input
```{r}
seurat_path  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds")
celltype_tsv <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "celltypes.tsv")
celltype_col <- "cell_type_manual"
```

# 3. Main Function
```{r}
run_linkpeaks_on_celltype <- function(
    obj_all, geneCoords, celltype_key,
    celltype_col = NULL,
    output_dir   = NULL,
    linkpeaks_args = list(
      peak.assay       = "ATAC",
      expression.assay = "RNA",
      peak.slot        = "counts",
      expression.slot  = "counts",
      method           = "pearson",
      distance         = 5e5,
      min.distance     = NULL,
      min.cells        = 10,
      n_sample         = 200,
      pvalue_cutoff    = 0.05,
      score_cutoff     = 0.05,
      gene.id          = FALSE,
      verbose          = TRUE
    )
) {
  key <- trimws(celltype_key)
  cat("\n===== Running LinkPeaks for:", key, "=====\n")
  
  if (!(celltype_col %in% colnames(obj_all@meta.data))) {
    stop("Metadata column '", celltype_col, "' not found in Seurat object.")
  }
  
  sel <- as.vector(obj_all[[celltype_col]][, 1]) == key
  n_sel <- sum(sel, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("  Cells in subset:", n_sel, "\n")
  
  safe_key <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", key)
  outfile  <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("linked_peaks_", safe_key, ".tsv"))
  
  obj <- obj_all[, sel]
  

  rna_feats <- rownames(obj[["RNA"]])     # symbols
  keep <- !is.na(geneCoords$gene_name) & (geneCoords$gene_name %in% rna_feats)
  gc2  <- geneCoords[keep]

  linked <- try({do.call(Signac::LinkPeaks, c(list(object=obj, gene.coords=gc2), linkpeaks_args))}, silent = TRUE)
  links_slot <- linked[["ATAC"]]@links
  out_df <- if (!is.null(links_slot)) {
    as.data.frame(links_slot)[, c("peak","gene","score"), drop=FALSE]
  } else {
    data.frame(peak=character(), gene=character(), score=numeric())
  }
  
  # Atomic write
  tmpfile <- tempfile(pattern = paste0("linked_peaks_", safe_key, "_"),
                      tmpdir = output_dir, fileext = ".tsv.tmp")
  data.table::fwrite(out_df, tmpfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
  ok <- file.rename(tmpfile, outfile); if (!ok) file.copy(tmpfile, outfile, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("  Saved: %s (n_links=%d)\n", outfile, nrow(out_df)))
  invisible(outfile)
}
```

# 4. Run
```{r}
cat("Reading Seurat object...\n")
obj_all <- readRDS(seurat_path)
anno <- Signac::Annotation(obj_all[["ATAC"]])
stopifnot(inherits(anno, "GRanges"))

if (!all(startsWith(seqlevels(anno), "chr"))) GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(anno) <- "UCSC"
common <- intersect(seqlevels(anno), seqlevels(obj_all[["ATAC"]]))
anno <- GenomeInfoDb::keepSeqlevels(anno, common, pruning.mode = "coarse")
anno <- GenomeInfoDb::keepStandardChromosomes(anno, pruning.mode = "coarse")

geneCoords <- anno  

cat("RegionStats + Annotation...\n")
obj_all <- Signac::RegionStats(
  object = obj_all,
  genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
  assay  = "ATAC",
  verbose = TRUE
)

# ------------------ Read cell types ------------------
df <- read.delim(celltype_tsv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
if (!"celltype_key" %in% names(df)) stop("<celltypes.tsv> must contain a column named 'celltype_key'.")
keys <- trimws(enc2utf8(df$celltype_key))
nkeys <- length(keys)

cat("Running LinkPeaks sequentially for", nkeys, "cell types...\n")

# ------------------ Loop over cell types ------------------
for (i in seq_along(keys)) {
  key <- keys[i]
  cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d] %s\n", i, nkeys, key))
  run_linkpeaks_on_celltype(obj_all, geneCoords, key, celltype_col, output_dir = output_dir)
}

cat("\nAll cell types processed.\n")
```
